city_evacuation.name: Evacuation courtyard
city_evacuation.description: Hold two approaches while Nara and Olen reach the protected muster point.

city_gate_repair.name: Gate repair winch
city_gate_repair.description: Protect the winch. Saboteurs approach from side lanes; cover blocks archers.

city_infirmary.name: Infirmary supplies
city_infirmary.description: Intercept ranged threats and their officer before they reach the medical stores.

veil_ritual.name: Rootsong ritual
veil_ritual.description: Protect the returned focus while residents reconnect one damaged root.

cinder_entry.restores: only first activation outside combat; repeats only choose recovery

cinder_shelter.restores: only first activation outside combat; repeats only choose recovery

cinder_upper.restores: only first activation outside combat; repeats only choose recovery

city_duelist_edge.name: Aurelian Duelist Edge
city_duelist_edge.description: +7 damage. Direct damage is reduced15%; the next direct ability within2s after a dash gains60% damage under existing pursuit rules.

city_rescue_plate.name: Evacuation Plate
city_rescue_plate.description: Only 2 ordinary armor; grants the existing protective rescue effect while reviving.

city_signal_focus.name: Militia Signal Focus
city_signal_focus.description: +4 damage. Projectiles chain using the conductor rules, trading away initial projectile damage.

veil_root_standard.name: Rootsong Standard
veil_root_standard.description: Support fields follow their caster but expire 40% sooner; only 1 armor.

veil_bond_staff.name: Living Bond Staff
veil_bond_staff.description: +4 damage. Existing summoner tradeoff improves summon health and reduces direct damage.

veil_echo_lens.name: Essence Echo Lens
veil_echo_lens.description: +4 damage. Arc Bolt gains the existing forked-lens jumps and range but loses first-hit damage.

cinder_pursuit_blade.name: Crownfire Pursuit Blade
cinder_pursuit_blade.description: +11 damage. Direct damage is reduced15%; one follow-up within2s after a dash gains60% damage under existing pursuit rules.

cinder_shelter_plate.name: Ash Shelter Plate
cinder_shelter_plate.description: 5 armor instead of the finest heavy plate; rescue protection supports dangerous revives.

cinder_pack_focus.name: Ember Pack Focus
cinder_pack_focus.description: +7 damage. Summons follow your selected visible target under pack-whistle rules; owner direct damage is reduced 25%.

city_field_dressing.name: City Field Dressing
city_field_dressing.description: Restore55 HP. A marked infirmary supply; one use.

veil_essence_vial.name: Rootsong Essence Vial
veil_essence_vial.description: Restore60 mana. One use; no cooldown reset.

cinder_heatward.name: Cinder Heatward
cinder_heatward.description: Take50% less damage for18 seconds. One use; no immunity to marked attacks.

abilities.name: Formation Break
abilities.description: Strike a 65 px wide,  235 px lane. Push ordinary foes 65 px; bosses instead receive a 0.35 s root.

abilities.name: Oath Link
abilities.description: Allies within 240 px receive 24 barrier for 6 s. Those within 100 px also receive 25% protection for 4 s.

abilities.name: Citadel Fall
abilities.description: Strike a 100 px wide,  260 px lane for 3× weapon damage; gain 30 barrier for 6 s.

passive.name: Muster
passive.effect: Completing a revive grants both hunters 24 barrier for 6 s.

modifier.name: Open the Formation
modifier.effect: Formation Break widens to 100 px; committed positioning still matters.

abilities.name: Ember Seam
abilities.description: Mark a 95 px circle at a visible foe within 330 px. Three 1 s pulses each deal 0.55× weapon damage.

abilities.name: Prism Fracture
abilities.description: Strike a 70 px wide,  300 px lane. Root ordinary foes 1.5 s and weaken their damage 30% for 3 s; bosses resist root.

abilities.name: Star Corridor
abilities.description: At a visible foe within 400 px, three 115 px pulses each deal 1.15× weapon damage. Pulses stun ordinary foes briefly.

passive.name: Alternation
passive.effect: Casting a different active skill than your previous one restores 3 mana, at most once per 4 s.

modifier.name: Retained Embers
modifier.effect: Ember Seam gains a fourth pulse; no shorter cooldown.

abilities.name: Pinning Line
abilities.description: Fire through a 50 px wide,  370 px lane. Each visible foe takes 1.1× weapon damage and a short root.

abilities.name: Snare Exchange
abilities.description: Move 90 px backwards through clear ground, leaving a 90 px snare field for 3 pulses; each deals 0.8× weapon damage and roots.

abilities.name: Arrow Corridor
abilities.description: Commit three 110 px arrow impacts at a selected visible cluster within 410 px, each 1.3× weapon damage.

passive.name: Patient Aim
passive.effect: After standing still for 1 s, your next direct hit gains 8 damage; once per 4 s.

modifier.name: Split Pins
modifier.effect: Pinning Line widens to 85 px; its damage and range stay.

abilities.name: Purging Salve
abilities.description: A visible target within 300 px anchors a 100 px mixture burst. Foes take weapon damage; living allies clear roots and regain 8 HP.

abilities.name: Sealed Vessel
abilities.description: Give the most wounded visible living ally 28 barrier and cleanse roots. Sacred vapour damages nearby foes for 0.7× weapon damage.

abilities.name: Lustral Front
abilities.description: A 100 px wide,  320 px sacred wave deals 2.6× weapon damage and heals visible allies along its lane 24 HP.

passive.name: Restorative Residue
passive.effect: Direct damage restores 4 HP to the nearest wounded living ally within 160 px, once per 4 s.

modifier.name: Shared Salve
modifier.effect: Purging Salve heals 14 instead of 8 per affected living ally.

abilities.name: Feint Cut
abilities.description: Cut visible foes within 100 px for 1.15× weapon damage, retreat 90 px through clear ground and conceal for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Shadow Anchor
abilities.description: Place a 6 s shadow anchor. After 3 s return through a clear line to it, gaining 16 barrier. Blocked returns stay in place safely.

abilities.name: Nightfall Execution
abilities.description: Strike the selected visible foe for 2.5× weapon damage, doubled below 30% health. Conceal for 1 s after the strike.

passive.name: Fresh Wound
passive.effect: Your first direct hit within 3 s of a dash applies 5 s bleed at 20% weapon damage, once per dash.

modifier.name: Lingering Feint
modifier.effect: Feint Cut conceals for 2 s after its retreat; attacking still reveals you.

abilities.name: Bramble Lane
abilities.description: A 110 px bramble field at a visible foe pulses three times:0.45× weapon damage and brief roots.

abilities.name: Renewal Exchange
abilities.description: Consume up to 20% current HP from each living summon, without killing it. Heal visible allies within 240 px by up to 24 HP each from that finite pool.

abilities.name: Pack Reckoning
abilities.description: Each living summon strikes visible foes within 110 px for 2× your weapon damage. You and nearby allies gain 20 barrier. Requires a living summon.

passive.name: Mutual Shelter
passive.effect: While a living owned summon is within 100 px, reduce incoming damage by 3; no extra summon HP or free healing.

modifier.name: Living Boundary
modifier.effect: Bramble Lane grows to 145 px; line-of-sight and root resistance remain.

abilities.name: Syncopated Break
abilities.description: A 90 px wide,  260 px sound lane deals 0.9× weapon damage and interrupts enemy channels. Allies in the lane gain 10 barrier.

abilities.name: Countermelody
abilities.description: For 6 s, nearby allies move 20% faster and take 20% less damage. Does not reset recharge or stack with a stronger ward.

abilities.name: Concordant Finale
abilities.description: A 310 px resonance deals 2.2× weapon damage, interrupts channels, heals allies 16 HP and grants 16 barrier.

passive.name: Relay
passive.effect: Completing a revive grants nearby living allies 25% movement speed for 5 s.

modifier.name: Shared Break
modifier.effect: Syncopated Break grants 18 instead of 10 barrier to allies in its lane.

abilities.name: Judgment Ray
abilities.description: A 55 px wide,  340 px ray deals 1.35× weapon damage. Each foe struck gives the most wounded nearby living ally 4 HP, capped 12 total.

abilities.name: Lifeline Surge
abilities.description: Heal the most wounded visible living ally 24 HP and give 16 barrier; foes within 90 px of that ally take weapon damage.

abilities.name: Dawn Deluge
abilities.description: Deal 2× weapon damage to visible foes within 290 px. Heal living allies 28 HP; downed allies gain a 24-point barrier for their next rescue, not an instant revive.

passive.name: Respite
passive.effect: Completing a revive heals you and the rescued ally 12 HP and clears their roots.

modifier.name: Merciful Judgment
modifier.effect: Judgment Ray can distribute up to 20 healing from enemies struck, without raising damage.

authoredCollision.rule: Finished scenery must match these authoritative footprints; props remain static by default.

artifactText.city_dispatch: Aurelian controls the grain roads. Its outer gate has fallen. Marshal Rhea asks the hunters who repaired Dunmere’s intake to secure the breach and protect civilian routes.
artifactText.city_militia_orders: The raiders are not acting alone. Three militia commanders divide the city. Each order bears Orath’s split-root seal: the same device later seen on the dragon’s collar.
artifactText.city_records: Nara, the granary keeper, and Olen, the evacuation clerk, were separated in the homes and archive districts. The protected courtyard is their muster point; securing their rescue does not require a long escort.
artifactText.city_medical_satchel: Sen’s marked field dressings were stolen from the infirmary. They can support the main infirmary defense and the surgeon’s optional supply request; both have fixed receipts.
artifactText.veil_siphon_records: Orath siphons the old root network to strengthen a command bond. The same split-root seal directs the city militia and the dragon’s collar. The dragon was his weapon, not the source of this extraction.
artifactText.veil_ward_fragment: This sanctuary ward uses the old woodland watch geometry. Damaged roots link the spring failures to Orath’s extraction, not a natural drought.
artifactText.veil_memory_tablet: Rootsong keeps names through songs and carved memory tablets. Foxfolk pathfinders, stagfolk keepers, owlfolk scholars and badgerfolk artisans share the same settlement; the grafted raiders do not represent its people.
artifactText.cinder_lair_seal: The vent ward identifies a safe route through the lair threshold. Keep it with the final pursuit; it takes no pouch space. Activate the four ascent sanctuaries and defeat the two route keepers before entering the dragon’s lair.

questOutcomes.city_call: Ilyan’s dispatch opens the eastern road from the pumping station to Aurelian. The repaired intake can supply a city refuge.
questOutcomes.city_breach: The breach is secured. Refuge and square routes open; Rhea can now coordinate named rescues and three critical defenses.
questOutcomes.city_rescue: Nara and Olen reach the refuge muster. Their names replace missing-person notices; the evacuation records are safe.
questOutcomes.city_evacuation: The courtyard evacuation is complete. Civilians shelter at the refuge; this finite assault cannot pay again.
questOutcomes.city_gate_repair: The gate mechanism holds. Defenders can reinforce the breach while hunters use the district loop.
questOutcomes.city_infirmary: Sen’s medical stores survive the attack. The refuge remains a recovery point.
questOutcomes.city_commanders: Varr, Sere and Kes are defeated. Their orders expose Orath’s militia. The upper terrace opens from archive and observatory.
questOutcomes.city_terrace: The dragon destroys the beacon, displays Orath’s collar seal and leaves. A magical disturbance leads through the eastern terrace into the Verdant Veil.
questOutcomes.veil_trust: Siv reaches Rootsong and the threshold path is repaired. Tess and Arven trust you with the failing pools and sanctuary wards.
questOutcomes.veil_imbalance: The pool, root and sanctuary evidence agree: deliberate siphoning is draining the old network.
questOutcomes.veil_siphons: Both siphon sites are disabled. Their records name Archmage Orath and identify the dragon’s command bond; his sanctum is open.
questOutcomes.veil_archmage: Orath is defeated. He owned and commanded the dragon through the split-root bond. Breaking it ends his control, but the still-destructive dragon flees to the Cinder Crown. Limited streams recover; pursue it before it returns.
questOutcomes.cinder_dragon: The dragon is dead, Orath’s threat is resolved and the main campaign is finished. Settlements and unfinished optional stories remain available in this completed save.
